QuestInfo.0: There's a cat stuck in a trap in Wolf Forest! You should definitely help, being an aspiring hero and all.
QuestInfo.1: You're going to save that cat! But how? As a soon-to-be hero, you easily realized you'd have to use a tool. \r\n\r\nPress the Ctrl key to tear down that trap!
QuestInfo.2: You smashed the trap to pieces. Hero style.
